goal_pol_original.gap: Requires the qualified prepared CH2O geometry first; a concrete RHF/def2-SVP static-polarizability input and an independent managed ORCA run cannot be authored without the real prepared_geometry artifact.

goal_rotation_relation.gap: The rotation convention can be defined, but the numerical rotated XYZ and its relation to the original require the prepared geometry.

goal_pol_rotated.gap: Requires an archived rotated XYZ derived from the prepared geometry and a separate managed ORCA run with identical settings; the rotated tensor may not be obtained by transforming the first result.

goal_deliver_results.gap: Depends on real outputs from both independent ORCA calculations, two archived XYZ files, the tensor table, isotropic values, and the comparison record.

goal_verify_tensors.gap: Requires both real 3x3 tensors from actual ORCA outputs before component-level rotation comparison and isotropic invariance checks.

goal_preserve_artifacts.gap: Generation/analysis scripts, XYZ files, input/output files, data tables, and limitations will be archived as each producer executes.

goal_seed_1701.gap: No random-number algorithm has been authored yet; seed 1701 will be recorded where applicable and any library limitation stated explicitly.

proposal.reason: Initial plan establishes the mandatory CH2O identity anchor and qualified prepared geometry for system_ch2o. structure.prepare binds its required input role identity to resolve_ch2o's actual output port resolved_identity; goal_prepare_ch2o is bound using the future producer step_key plus its unchanged port, not as pre-existing evidence. The remaining goals are recorded with gaps because concrete ORCA inputs and tensor comparisons require the real prepared geometry artifact first. After inspecting the prepare receipt, I will revise the plan to write the original and rotated XYZ files, author matching RHF/def2-SVP static-polarizability inputs, execute two independent managed ORCA calculations, then create the tensor/verification/rotation/artifact records from actual outputs.
